items.title: Shareholder Proposal 4: Report on congruence of security, resiliency, and climate initiatives
items.subtitle: Submitted by National Legal and Policy Center

facts.proposalTitle: Report on congruence of security, resiliency, and climate initiatives
facts.resolved: Shareholders request that the Board of Directors publish a report, prepared at reasonable cost and omitting proprietary or legally privileged information, describing the Board's oversight and evaluation for how the Company's Security and Resiliency Initiative is congruent with existing climate-related commitments.

evidence.label: Proponent
evidence.quote: National Legal and Policy Center has advised us that it intends to introduce the following resolution

evidence.label: Board recommendation
evidence.quote: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal

facts.resolved: Shareholders request that the Board of Directors adopt an enduring policy, and amend the governing documents as necessary including the Corporate Governance Guidelines in order that 2 separate people hold the office of the Chairman and the office of the CEO as soon as possible.

items.title: Shareholder Proposal 6: Lobbying alignment
items.subtitle: Submitted by The Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate

facts.proponent: The Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate
facts.resolved: Shareholders request the Board of Directors take steps to analyze and report to shareholders (at reasonable cost and omitting confidential information) on the alignment of JPMorgan Chase's lobbying and public policy advocacy with its stated public policy positions.

items.title: Shareholder Proposal 7: Sustainability ROI report
items.subtitle: Submitted by The National Center for Public Policy Research

facts.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
facts.resolved: Shareholders request the Board of Directors issue a report by the next annual meeting, at reasonable cost and omitting proprietary information, assessing whether and to what extent the Company's sustainability investments referenced in its 2024 Sustainability Report were authorized based on positive Net Present Value (NPV) analysis and are maintained based on quantifiable Return on Investment (ROI) metrics.
